title: Rally Agent now lives in the Rally app, and a fresh platform look
body_markdown:
Recent product udpates have brought the Rally Agent directly into the Rally app, so your team can get AI-powered assistance where you are already running studies. Rally also got a refreshed look, upgraded first-class integrations for AI-moderated tests, and a set of governance and scheduling controls that keep research running inside the guardrails you set.


### ` General Availability`


### 🤖 The Rally Agent now lives in the Rally app


Get AI-powered help without switching apps. Ask Rally is now available directly in Rally for agent-enabled workspaces, with chat, threads, and a study-side panel that keeps assistance alongside your research workflows.


‍


### 🎨 A fresh look for Rally


Rally has a fresh look. Our updated visual theme is available in both light and dark mode and brings the refreshed Rally brand into the app without changing any workflows. Participant-facing pages are unchanged.


### 🔌 First-class integrations for AI-moderated tests - Dialogue and Listen Labs


Dialogue and Listen Labs connect directly to Rally, so your team can run AI-moderated sessions in the tool you already use, while Rally handles the participant side: recruiting, completion tracking, incentives and governance.


‍


## Now in Early Access


### 📆 Keep interview coordination in one place


Stay on top of what’s next and revisit what you’ve learned, all in one place. See upcoming and past interviews, access recordings, and switch between your own interviews and your team’s for a clear view of research activity.


*Interested in this feature? Request Early Access with your Customer Success Manager.*


### 🛡️ Data Deletion in Early Access


Keep your participant database aligned with your data retention policies without manual cleanup. Admins set retention rules that automatically queue matching participants for deletion. After a configurable waiting period, Rally removes their personal data while preserving study activity and aggregate reporting.
